sources.name: US National Archives UAP bulk catalogue
sources.notes: The official catalogue links metadata JSON separately from very large ZIP media bundles.

sources.name: US Department of War PURSUE UAP release index
sources.notes: Official release portal contains both searchable records and multi-GB document/video bundles; retain a manifest before any selected file acquisition.

sources.name: CNES GEIPAN official cases and witness-observations CSV
sources.privacy_note: Published coordinates are rounded to 0.1 degree and witness-related data are anonymized/filtered; local header inspection checks the relation contract before any row import.

sources.name: Spain Ministry of Defence declassified UFO files
sources.record_count_note: Official presentation describes 80 declassified files / approximately 1,900 pages covering Spanish airspace incidents from 1962 to 1995.
sources.metadata_capability_note: Individual catalogue pages expose a Download METS action; the anonymous endpoint returned HTTP 403 during admission research, so endpoint behavior and permitted catalogue traversal remain unverified.

sources.name: UFOSINT unified public sightings SQLite export
sources.privacy_note: The documented public export strips long narratives and raw JSON; the local adapter additionally omits witness fields and rounds map coordinates to 0.1 degree before any derived export.
sources.deduplication_note: This is an aggregator-derived view; retain source_db_id/source_record_id/origin provenance and never count it in addition to its upstream feeds.

sources.name: Phenomainon research MCP/API
sources.record_count_note: API documentation described a 252K-event corpus at admission; treat the count as provider-reported and time-varying.
sources.access_note: MCP/API uses X-API-Key. Anonymous access is rate-limited; vetted free researcher access is documented for non-commercial research, journalism and education.
sources.redistribution_status: provider compilation/normalization is proprietary; legal page permits non-commercial API/MCP use but does not grant a bulk mirror license
sources.deduplication_note: Every event preserves upstream citations. Use only for candidate discovery/corroboration and never add its event count to its listed upstream catalogs.

sources.name: Global Meteor Network meteor trajectories
sources.coverage_note: Meteor trajectories include beginning time and start/end latitude/longitude; a local plan constrains an approved future collector to a 31-day, composite-cursor page rather than an unbounded full-table request.

sources.name: National UFO Archive of Ukraine
sources.notes: The public API page documents an external map widget that loads current archive data; it is not yet evidence of a licensed bulk-export contract.

sources.name: UfoSeti public map and API
sources.api_protocol_note: Published API examples use HTTP JSON/XML endpoints; do not auto-collect until transport, terms, pagination, and privacy scope are rechecked.

sources.name: Brazil National Archives OVNI collection
sources.record_count_note: The official collection notice reported 743 records (1952-2016); a later collection overview says holdings include OVNI records through 2019.
sources.notes: SIAN supports discovery and access to digitized documents, but a bulk export contract has not been confirmed.

sources.name: Library and Archives Canada UFO government records
sources.record_count_note: Official guide reports approximately 9,500 digitized documents from four federal departments/agencies, 1947 to the early 1980s.
sources.metadata_capability_note: LAC states Collection Search result lists can be exported as HTML/CSV/XML/JSON; verify query scope and terms before automated metadata collection.

sources.name: Argentina Centro de Identificación Aeroespacial
sources.notes: The official page says the center continues public case-resolution service and annual publication; no machine-readable all-case archive was verified.

sources.name: Chile DGAC SEFAA resolved-case publications
sources.record_count_note: Official site accepts reports and publishes resolved cases by year; no stable all-case bulk export or API was verified.
sources.notes: Treat published cases and media as selected official records, not a complete national reporting denominator.

sources.name: National Archives of Australia RAAF UFO records
sources.notes: Official archive confirms retained RAAF UFO sighting records, but a stable public all-record export contract has not been verified. Build a series/item manifest before any image or PDF acquisition.

sources.name: China UFO Exploration Network archive index
sources.notes: A Chinese-language historical archive/index is publicly visible, but no nationwide machine-readable or rights-cleared bulk dataset has been verified.
